AIDER -- Aerial Image Dataset for Emergency Response applications
Classes used: collapsed_building / fire / flood / traffic_incident / normal
Public source: https://zenodo.org/records/3888300 (Kyrkou & Theocharides, AIDER)
Project page: https://github.com/ckyrkou/AIDER

Usage in this study:
- Downloaded the public AIDER image folders and built a stratified train/val/test
  split; the exact split (file lists + labels) is recorded in
  artifacts/derived/aider_rcg/aider_splits.json so evaluation is reproducible
  without redistributing the copyrighted images.
- To reproduce from raw images, point run_aider_resolution.py at your local
  AIDER root (set the AIDER_ROOT environment variable) and regenerate the split.
